card.name: Partway through names starting with J
card.fires_on: Short pieces inside proper names, acronyms or web addresses that begin with J (Jwa, JRA, Jacquelyn, Jobst, Jacquemont). It fires on the piece right after the J.

modes.label: J-initial acronyms and URLs
modes.description: The letters after J in abbreviations or web domains such as JWA or JRA.
modes.example: JWA use only on j<<wa>>.org Kheel Center

modes.label: J-initial personal names
modes.description: The next piece inside a person's name starting with J, in citations or bylines.
modes.example: S. Jacquem<<ont>> et al. 'Mirror extreme BMI phen

card.writes: Promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed name fragments, so no clear output effect beyond continuing a name.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of names and abbreviations that start with J, like JRA or jwa.org.
